name: zocks-advisor
description: Seven skills for financial advisors, built exclusively on Zocks' structured meeting intelligence: behavioral profiles and relationship temperature, attrition-risk ranking, a held-away asset pipeline, client journey dossiers, annual review packs, next-best-action analysis, and a two-horizon tax opportunity scan. Every skill requires the Zocks MCP connection and refuses to run without it — no transcript uploads or other connectors can substitute.
